title: The Throat of the World
description: After deciphering Alduin's Wall, the Dragonborn learns that Alduin was defeated by a Shout called Dragonrend. Arngeir cannot teach it but directs the Dragonborn to Paarthurnax at the summit of the Throat of the World. After learning Clear Skies to bypass the magical winds, the Dragonborn meets Paarthurnaxâ€”who reveals he does not know Dragonrend either, but believes it can be learned from the ancient heroes through an Elder Scroll at the Time-Wound.

base_facts: I am the foremost of the Greybeards and speak for our order.
The Shout used to defeat Alduin is called Dragonrend, but I do not know it and its origins are lost to us.
Only Paarthurnax, our leader who dwells at the summit of the Throat of the World, may know Dragonrend.
I can teach you the Clear Skies Shout to clear the path through the magical winds blocking the way to the summit.

SEEK_ARNGEIR: The Dragonborn has come seeking knowledge of the Shout that defeated Alduin. I will help them reach Paarthurnax.
LEARN_CLEAR_SKIES: I have taught the Dragonborn all three words of Clear Skies so they may ascend to the Throat of the World.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Dragonborn has returned from Paarthurnax seeking an Elder Scroll to look back through the Time-Wound and learn Dragonrend from the ancient Tongues.
I may be able to help the Dragonborn locate an Elder Scroll, or Esbern of the Blades may have knowledge of its whereabouts.

base_facts: I am Paarthurnax, leader of the Greybeards and a dragon who has chosen the Way of the Voice.
I have lived in seclusion at the summit of the Throat of the World for thousands of years.
I do not know the Dragonrend Shout, as it was created by mortals to defy dragons.

REACH_PAARTHURNAX: The Dragonborn has reached my mountain. We must observe the formalities of the dov before we speak.
LEARN_FIRE_BREATH: I have shared the Word Yolâ€”Fireâ€”with the Dragonborn as a gift of understanding between dov.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I do not know Dragonrend, but I believe it can be learned by looking back through the Tiid-Ahraan—the Time-Wound—here on the Throat of the World. An Elder Scroll, a Kel, is needed to open the way and witness the ancient.
I do not know where an Elder Scroll might be found. The Dragonborn must ask Arngeir or Esbern for that knowledge.
If the Dragonborn already possesses an Elder Scroll, they should bring it to the Time-Wound at once so we may look back to the moment Alduin was first defeated.

beats.comment: Player returns to High Hrothgar and asks Arngeir about the Shout used to defeat Alduin. Arngeir reveals Dragonrend and directs player to Paarthurnax.
Arngeir teaches all three words of Clear Skies in the courtyard so the player can ascend past the magical winds.
Player uses Clear Skies to pass the magical winds and reaches Paarthurnax at the summit. Paarthurnax initiates the formal greeting of the dov.
Paarthurnax shares the Word of Power for Fire Breath and asks the player to Shout at him as part of the formalities of the dov.

Paarthurnax explains Dragonrend is unknown to him but can be learned through the Time-Wound using an Elder Scroll. Quest finishes; player is directed to Arngeir or Esbern for the Elder Scroll's location.
